trophies.guide: This is the reward for earning the other 54 trophies, so there is no separate task to chase. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, which makes this a long grind rather than a hard one. The biggest time sink is A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, followed by the 250 stunts and the 100 WAiNK scans. Work through the roadmap in order: finish the five story chapters, then clear the 100% checklist that appears under Progress, Stats, after the credits. Keep cheats off your trophy save, since they switch off trophies and saving.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is one of the first missions of Chapter 1, so this pops very early in a normal playthrough. Just follow the mission prompts and finish it; nothing in it can be missed, and there is no mission replay to worry about because story missions only need to be completed once. It is hidden on PlayStation until you earn it, which is why the spoiler setting in this guide hides it by default. GTABase lists it as a Chapter 1 story trophy that cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter ends. GTABase notes the trophy can pop when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins rather than on the final cutscene, so do not worry if it is a little late. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation, because that spot disappears once the chapter ends and it feeds the Positive Mental Attitude trophy. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter anyway, since the game has no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's missions. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens up during this chapter, which also unlocks most of the partner trophies and side content, so take side jobs as they appear. GTABase says this trophy is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the Welcome to Vice City mission. Save at the start of the chapter in one of the 15 manual slots, since there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 3. This chapter opens several trophy tools, including the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which you need for Sneakthief, and the Key Cloner mission that leads to Randy's car list. GTABase notes the trophy arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so keep playing into the next chapter if it has not popped yet. Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 3 in case anything time-sensitive slips past.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 4's missions, including the story missions Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown, which each have their own trophies. Near the end of the chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens bank vault robberies, which feed Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together, so take it when it appears. The trophy cannot be missed; it pops as the chapter closes. Save at the start of the chapter and keep one untouched save from just before the final mission later on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story to earn this gold. Before you start it, make a manual save you never overwrite, because the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Free roam carries on after the credits, so everything else on the list can be cleaned up afterwards, and the 100% checklist only appears under Progress, Stats, once the story is done. GTABase confirms no trophy depends on how you play a mission, so there are no medal or difficulty requirements to worry about.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 story mission, so this trophy comes naturally as you play through the chapter. There is nothing extra to do beyond finishing the mission, and it cannot be missed. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned, so the guide's spoiler setting keeps its name and description covered until you tick it off. Check the walkthrough order in Output Lag or GTABase if you want to know where it falls in the chapter.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission, and finishing it is all this trophy asks. Output Lag counts it among the twelve unmissable hidden story trophies, so just play the story through and it will pop with no side content needed. Because it is hidden, the guide hides it behind the spoiler setting until earned. No preparation, collectible or side quest feeds into it, and no medal or difficulty requirement applies to any story mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 story mission, so this trophy unlocks by playing the story normally. Output Lag counts it among the twelve unmissable hidden story trophies, so it cannot be missed and needs no side content. Like the other story trophies it stays hidden on PlayStation until you earn it. Keep a chapter-start save as usual, but this one needs no special timing, and no medal or difficulty requirement applies to any story mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 4 story mission, and completing it earns this trophy automatically. Output Lag counts it among the twelve unmissable hidden story trophies, so there is nothing to plan around beyond playing the chapter through. The trophy is hidden until earned, which is why it sits behind the spoiler setting in this guide. No collectibles, races or side strands are involved, and no medal or difficulty requirement applies to any story mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission at Vice City International Airport, and finishing it is the whole requirement. It cannot be missed, so just follow the mission through. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned. Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can, the separate free-roam trophy for stealing a passenger jet from the same airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission, so this trophy comes from playing the final chapter through. It is unmissable and needs no preparation. Keep the manual save you made before the final mission, since this is the last chapter and there is no mission replay afterwards. The trophy stays hidden until you earn it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: This is the hardest trophy on the list and the main reason the platinum takes around 200 hours. The checklist appears after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but everything you did earlier already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx notes it is closer to 60% of true completion: it asks for all robberies, the 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, every shooting range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, plus partial shares of the rest, such as 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts. Work on it steadily during the story, scanning vehicles and animals as you go, then finish the leftovers in free roam after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Any mix of stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps counts toward the 250. GTABase counts 397 stunts in total, so you do not need them all, and flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up. The optional challenge on each stunt is not needed for the trophy. Track your count under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and use the map's Stunt Spot markers. Keep going past 250, because the 100% checklist wants 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball by sinking one basket, an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt. GTABase lists the race as any car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race. Check Progress, Activities, to see which types you still have left. Most of these come naturally while chasing other trophies, so it usually pops on its own during a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge, 42 golds across 12 ranges according to GTABase, with two ranges in total per Output Lag. Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so practice here before attempting that trophy. There are no difficulty settings in the game, so this is a skill and patience test rather than a build check. Ranges stay open after the story, so you can finish this in free roam at your own pace.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough for this trophy. GTABase notes the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so it is worth finishing every race at a location while you are there rather than coming back later. Drone races stay available after the story. If a location is giving you trouble, retry it immediately, since there is no penalty for losing a race.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 available, according to GTABase. Winning the same race again does not count, so keep moving to new events instead of farming a favourite. Races include car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races, which means the wins from Top Fun also feed this total. Races stay open after the story, so mop up any shortfall in free roam.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, after which he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests until he offers his challenge, then beat him in it. Fishing also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None. Cal's quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush if you meet him early and move on.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. GTABase says three of them, Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, are on the TV at home, while the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick whichever game you find easiest and play it through to its end. Arcade games also count as one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. GTABase lists five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass, with the last one awarding the trophy. They stay available after the story, so finish them in free roam if you miss them during the chapter. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which tracks different stranger quests.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton, marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento, hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig each one up, and track progress under Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures. GTABase notes he disappears after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again later, so you can finish the strand then. The final mission for him awards the trophy, and it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. GTABase names the fifth job Hometown Heroes as the one that unlocks the trophy. The jobs stay available after the story, so there is no deadline. Like Andy's strand, Billy's does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which only tracks certain stranger quests.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands. GTABase confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count, while the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not, because several of those have their own trophies. The remaining qualifying strands were still being confirmed at launch, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list after each strand you finish. Watch out for one time-sensitive job: Output Lag flags Race Against Yago, a Chapter 3 race in Yago's street racing strand marked with an hourglass icon, so save first and race the moment it appears. Stranger strands are not part of 100% and stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner, Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City, marked with the RK icon. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; GTABase suggests hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach as the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more, so deliver them undamaged when you can.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, he has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough labs are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy. The strand stays available after the story, so you can finish it in free roam. Tyrone's line does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which tracks different stranger quests.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot until the counter reaches 18. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and GTABase says meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, so bring your partner every time. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The last spot needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The one spot you can lose is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: the morning after Down to Earth, follow her from the kitchen to the balcony and accept the optional task, and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops, since it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it.
trophies.missableNote: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter ends. Do it the morning after the mission Down to Earth: follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task. Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks, marked with purple icons, and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. GTABase notes which animal triggers the trophy was not confirmed at launch, and the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so work through the decks and it should pop along the way. Hunting also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any three Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so pick the three nearest to completion and hunt their missing cards first. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so grab them while you are travelling for other trophies rather than making dedicated trips. Nothing about the sets is missable, and they stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app by holding Up on the D-pad, then R1 or RB. GTABase says any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Make scanning a habit while you travel, since the same app is how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good. The 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK scans too, so this trophy and the checklist line up exactly.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges, which you can review under Progress, Challenges, where finished ones get a tick. Many complete on their own while you play, so check the list regularly and chase the easy ones first, such as stunts, races and scans that overlap with other trophies. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so this trophy comes along the way and you should keep going past 50. Challenges are never missable and stay open after the story.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: This opens once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad, then Triangle or Y, then build a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area. GTABase suggests the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County for shaking off cops and helicopters. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so this often pops while you are working on Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while you are still wanted, shown by the flashing red and blue. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks, so move fast between shops and do not let the heat die down. Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. GTABase points to the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, which open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, because they sit close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop, so give it a moment before robbing a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic to build the total quickly. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so you will get this trophy anyway on the way there. Scanning also feeds Randy's Wish List checks for Supply & Demand, so keep the app open while you drive.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim, triggered by clicking both sticks while aiming. Fill your Focus first by eating, drinking or washing up at home, and use Adrenaline to make it last longer, since one use only lasts a few seconds. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. GTABase notes cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count, so choose gang thugs as your targets. Shooting ranges raise your Focus level, which makes this easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. GTABase says the planes at gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge. Get up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed, so fly about 1 km away from the airport before expecting it to pop, and save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank, a Rhino, from Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the far southwest of the map; GTABase places the tanks at the south end of the base. Save first, get in, and drive and fire at enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance from the military, so do not linger outside the tank. The trophy stays available after the story, so attempt it in free roam when you are well equipped.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it, since kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on, because detection fails the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner and hand them a bag. Vaults always give a 4-star Wanted Level, so escape on a fast bike and then switch vehicles; escaping with your partner also earns Hot Together. Five of the eight vaults are enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all eight, and each pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts for this trophy too, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray, so it often pops while you are working on Maximum Withdrawal. Before vaults open, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away. Either way, the escape matters: the trophy only pops once you are clear of the heat, not the moment you grab the cash. Save before you try, since armored truck crews fight back.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida to cover all 52 areas. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch on the map until nothing is left hidden. Do this after the story, when the full map is open and you can fly freely. Exploring also helps you spot WAiNK locations, meditation spots and stunt sites for other trophies, so it doubles as scouting for the long grind.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation, shown by yellow map icons, from each of the nine gangs. Progress, Gangs, keeps count of which gangs you have hit. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way to that goal. Kingpin Bowling is one such operation, and it also feeds Let's Go Bowling, so plan your robberies to overlap with other trophies where you can.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method exists for this trophy at launch, and this guide will not invent one. GTABase says only to have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City, and adds that the exact steps are not confirmed yet. Your best bet is to visit bars and viewpoints along Ocean Beach and try ordering a drink where the game offers the option, then check back for an updated guide. Do not grind blindly: the trophy is worth 5 Gamerscore and may trigger from a specific story moment rather than a repeatable action.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method exists for this trophy at launch, and this guide will not invent one. The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, which GTABase also reports as unconfirmed. Try driving a car through a showroom's glass front in Vice City and see if it pops, but expect the real trigger to be a specific showroom or story beat. Check back for an updated guide once players pin it down, rather than repeating the same attempt.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Bring sticky bombs and take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway, which you blow open with a sticky bomb. The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so grab everything in one run if you can.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia; check Jason and Lucia, Strength, in the pause menu to see your progress. Work out at fitness clubs, found under Map, Activities, with your partner along, since training one trains the other too. Output Lag notes you should buy a gym membership and train together, and GTABase adds that after the story you can also train at home. This is a slow grind, so start early and train whenever you pass a gym.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying, because robberies, fights and other crimes all feed the count. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, to watch the number climb. GTABase warns not to push toward the Irredeemable profile, because it is permanent, so let the total build up naturally from normal play instead of farming crimes. This trophy is hidden until earned, and it is not missable.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method exists for this trophy at launch, and this guide will not invent one. The description, second time's the charm, suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, which GTABase also reports as unconfirmed. It may be tied to failing and then passing a specific event, so do not force failures everywhere hoping it pops. Treat it as a trophy to revisit once the community pins down the trigger, and check back for an updated guide.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method exists for this trophy at launch, and this guide will not invent one. GTABase expects a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida, and the description reads like a reaction to something bizarre. Explore odd locations and watch for unusual encounters while you are doing other trophies, especially in remote parts of the map. Check back for an updated guide once players identify the event, rather than hunting blind.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method exists for this trophy at launch, and this guide will not invent one. The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle, a melee drive-by, which GTABase also reports as unconfirmed. The bowling name suggests it may involve knocking down several people at once, possibly near the bowling alley, but that is a guess, not a confirmed step. Try melee drive-bys from a slow vehicle in crowded areas and check back for an updated guide once the trigger is known.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts; the total is cumulative, so it builds up over the whole game. The Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, Meet Raul's Crew, gets you the Dye Pack Jammer, after which you can rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills. Sell the bills to fences, and GTABase says Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The robberies needed for 100% completion will get you most of the way there without a separate grind.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest, according to GTABase, so buy weapons and upgrades as you go rather than saving it all for the end. Money from bank vaults and other robberies helps fund it, and each vault pays up to $205,000. The total is a running count, so normal shopping during a full playthrough usually covers most of it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, so fund them with robbery money, since each bank vault pays up to $205,000. The four garages the story gives you do not count toward this trophy. Garages also give you the free space you need to register vehicles for On the Spot, so buy them before you start registering cars.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission opens the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too. You need free garage space for each registration, so buy garages for Little Boxes first, and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes. Ten registrations earn the trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
